thread:
elaine: Heads-up: legal flagged an embed-model swap for next month. New embed model `redwood-embed-v3` uses 1536 dims vs v2's 1024. We need a short deprecation notice + migration guide and a compatibility strategy for customers using the public hosted API.

tom: Oof. That dimension change will break cosine-search clients. We should publish an explicit two-step migration: 1) announce deprecation window for v2, 2) provide fast conversion snippets + an embed similarity fallback (auto-rescore with cross-encoder).

vikram: Agree. I'll draft a PR template for the docs with these sections: impact summary, timeline, recommended code edits (JS/Python/Go), and a smoke-test checklist for SDKs.

lena: Can we include an example of computing a fallback score in JS? Something lightweight people can drop into existing pipelines while they reindex.

elain e: sure — suggestion for the guide: show both reindex path and short-term runtime mitigation (normalize dims + call cross-encoder endpoint). Also call out costs and latency tradeoffs.

vikram: Draft snippet for quick fallback (JS):
```js
// runtime fallback: old-vector -> pad/truncate to 1536 or map with PCA mapping
function padVector(v, target=1536) {
  if (v.length >= target) return v.slice(0, target);
  return v.concat(new Array(target-v.length).fill(0));
}
// simple example: pad then cosine with new model vectors
```

tom: That'll work for tiny corpora. For larger-scale we should recommend re-embedding and include a reindex checklist and sample batch job using our data-plane tooling. Add infra runbook: recommended shard sizes, batch concurrency, and retry semantics.

docops-bot: New draft PR created by vikram: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/13001 — title: "embed v2->v3: deprecation notice and migration guide" — checks running.

lena: Also add a redirect rule so old docs links to `/v2/embed` map to the new migration page while v2 is still live. External partner docs often link to the v2 page.

vikram: I'll add a redirects entry and a short snippet showing how to detect vector-dim mismatches (server-side).

elaine: Ops ask: can we include customer communication copy? Legal wants a plain-language blurb for the account teams. I'll paste a draft into the PR comments.

ci-bot: docs-staging build #901 started for PR 13001.

vikram: Also: SDKs need a minor bump because we will add a runtime warning when users send 1024-dim vectors to the embeddings endpoint. Need coordinated SDK release notes and error code `EMBED_DIM_MISMATCH` with guidance.

tom: I'll open the SDK changelog PRs after the docs merge. We should freeze swagger/IDL until the deprecation window starts to avoid churn.

lena: For examples, include a short python reindex job using our `redwood-cli` tool to recreate embeddings at scale (showing sample concurrency flags).

vikram: Pushed an update to PR with: deprecation timeline (90 days), sample code (JS runtime fallback + python reindex), redirects entry, and a short monitoring checklist (error rate, reindex progress).

docops-bot: CI passed for PR 13001 — staging link: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/embed-v2-to-v3-migration

ci-bot: smoke tests started against dedicated staging clusters.

elaine: @tom @vikram once staging smoke tests pass, I'll schedule an email to affected customers and the account team. Legal approved the wording.

lena: Small nit: call out that legacy `embed-model` alias will be live for the first 30 days then removed; recommend customers pin model ids in their config.

tom: Reviewed and left a few inline edits about cross-encoder costs. Non-blocking.

vikram: Merged. I'll follow up with the SDK warning PR and add an ops playbook for reindex rollback if needed.

elaine: Great. Closing thread; will post customer comms here after send.

lena: Thanks everyone.
